china-1925-6:p0469_2.rationale: Investments held against Post Office Savings Bank accounts: government and railway loans, municipal debentures, bank deposits, land and mortgages. Core subject is financial holdings; the postal savings channel is explicit.

china-1925-6:p0470_1.rationale: Floating balances of the Post Office Savings Bank, Big Dollar and Small Coin accounts, in Peking and districts. One district figure is unreadable but the structure shows the intended quantities.

china-1925-6:p0471_1.rationale: Summary statistics of the Chinese government telegraph network: line length, cables, instruments, offices and traffic.

china-1925-6:p0471_2.rationale: Lengths and construction dates of principal telegraph lines.

china-1925-6:p0471_3.rationale: Per-word tariff for domestic telegrams, in foreign languages and in Chinese, by destination and for press messages.

china-1925-6:p0472_1.rationale: Telegraph offices and overland and submarine line mileage by province at the end of 1922.

china-1925-6:p0475_1.rationale: Inventory of wireless stations with ownership, control, ranges, power, wavelength and remarks. Mixed quantitative and textual content, so statistical. These are radio telegraphy stations, and radio is the closest available tag.
review_questions: Wireless telegraphy stations: is the radio tag preferable to telegraph?

china-1925-6:p0477_1.rationale: Continuation list of wireless stations with ranges, power, wavelengths and control by country. Mixed content, so statistical.

china-1925-6:p0478_1.rationale: Wireless stations in operation or under construction, with power, wavelength and controlling authority. Mixed content, so statistical.

china-1925-6:p0479_1.rationale: Planned radio stations to be erected by a foreign company, with power ratings, plus a count of the 45 stations by controlling nationality.
